timing: Frozen before live RTC or received-audio ASR.
scope: All four whole received streams, original order; no trimming/retries/success selection.
method: Pinned local offline production Parakeet ASR, whole mono PCM16 resampled 24→16kHz. ASR is a proxy, not human listening.

review.cancel: Final reply affirms confirmed airport navigation cancellation, not that there was no active navigation. Initial old reply may be truncated. Backend cleared route separately verified.
review.repeat: Final reply affirms active airport navigation replacing office and88-minute estimate. Initial airport/middle office replies are intentionally interrupted and need not be complete in ASR; declared summaries/effects remain audited.
review.errors: Retain every number/name variant or missing fact; do not normalize away errors.

limitations: Reused synthetic development inputs and two repeated cases, not held-out FDB evaluation or human microphone/echo evidence.
Four fixed-order serial rooms and shared models do not support population accuracy, causal latency or concurrent-room capacity claims.
Client PCM receipt, speech-handle state and physical audible stop are different boundaries.
Planner optional lookup/cached read changes can alter physical attempt count; effects and allowable attempt chains are checked separately.
Default ICE/STUN may use network services although model inference stays local.
Private SDK sender identity shim is restricted to the reviewed installed source hash.
Initial/middle result speech is deliberately interrupted; full wording is assessed only for final replies.
